title: WHEN STRIVING EXHAUSTS YOU
JOHN 15:5 MIDDAY PRAYER
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: sunlight streaming through quiet wooden desk midday
dry grapevine leaves illuminated by noon sun
peaceful orchard trees in midday sunlight
lush grapevine branches under clear blue midday sky
calm mountain lake sun shining at noon
open wooden table with midday light through window

scenes.a: Your strength feels thin from striving alone today.
You try to force results from your own exhausted effort, forgetting where real life grows.
Hear the Savior in John fifteen verse five:
I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
scenes.sub: WITHOUT ME YE CAN DO NOTHING

scenes.a: Lord, we yield our restless work back to your hands. Teach us to abide in you right here, trusting you for what we cannot produce.
Quiet our hurried minds in your grace. Amen. Return to peace when your strength feels thin from striving alone.
